### Right-turning drivers from the south approach vs pedestrians in the east crosswalk

Right-turning car vs pedestrian · 4 verified close calls · worst margin 0.7 s · median 1.05 s

Events: EV_A1_0023, EV_A1_0060, EV_A2_0028, EV_A3_0026
